title: Clamp a number to inclusive bounds
instruction: Fix clamp(value, low, high). Return the nearest bound for out-of-range values; preserve in-range values. low <= high is guaranteed. Preserve existing tests and CI. You may add new tests under tests/. Do not weaken assertions or skip tests.

files.src/solution.py:
def clamp(value, low, high):
    return min(low, max(value, high))

title: Retain the final partial chunk
instruction: Fix chunks(values, size). Return consecutive lists of at most size items, retaining a nonempty final partial chunk. size <= 0 raises ValueError. Preserve existing tests and CI. You may add new tests under tests/. Do not weaken assertions or skip tests.

files.src/solution.py:
def chunks(values, size):
    return [values[i:i+size] for i in range(0, len(values)-size+1, size)]
